name: ci-check
description: Run lint and tests in parallel, analyze coverage, then notify with pipeline results

agents.name: lint-checker
agents.prompt: Run linting on all source files and report violations by severity

agents.name: test-runner
agents.prompt: Execute the full test suite and collect pass/fail results with timing

agents.name: coverage-reporter
agents.prompt: Analyze test coverage data and check against the 80% threshold

agents.name: deploy-notifier
agents.prompt: Compile lint, test, and coverage results into a notification and send to the configured channel
